actions: SORT SORT-WORK ON ASCENDING KEY SR-ACCT-NO SR-TRAN-ID USING TRAN-IN GIVING TRAN-OUT

rules.sentence: When `SORT-RETURN` is not 0, it runs `SORT SORT-WORK ON ASCENDING KEY SR-ACCT-NO SR-TRAN-ID USING TRAN-IN GIVING TRAN-OUT`, displays `'TXSORT: SORT FAILED '` `SORT-RETURN`, sets `RETURN-CODE` to 16, and stops the run.
When `SORT-RETURN` is 0, it runs `SORT SORT-WORK ON ASCENDING KEY SR-ACCT-NO SR-TRAN-ID USING TRAN-IN GIVING TRAN-OUT`, sets `RETURN-CODE` to 0, and stops the run.
